messages:
sam: Quick q — manager needs to submit an out-of-cycle band change for an IC in EMEA. What exact docs do we need, any payroll cutoff concerns, and can the change be retroactive to the start of the FY?

michelle: Short answer: manager evidence form + calibration notes + updated comp sheet. Payroll cutoff matters for effective date. Backdating is possible but limited (see below). Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/manager-evidence-form :point_right:

jordan: For the comp sheet, do we want a currency-converted number or the local currency? Also which approvers are required for EMEA?

michelle: Local currency on the comp sheet is preferred, add USD conversion as a note. Approvals: manager -> skip-level -> People Ops comp reviewer -> final signoff from Comp Committee if > 12% change or title bump across bands. If it's a small bump (<12%) and within budget, we can fast-track.

sam: Got it. What about timeline — if manager files today, when would payroll pick it up?

michelle: Timeline breakdown:
- Day 0: manager submits the evidence form + updated comp sheet (attach offer letter if applicable).
- Day 0-3: People Ops reviewer checks completeness and asks clarifying Qs.
- Day 3-7: Approvals routed (skip-level & comp reviewer).
- Day 7-10: Comp Committee (only for escalations/large changes).
- Next payroll cycle: if approval completed before payroll cutoff (usually the 20th of the month for salaried EMEA payroll), the effective date can be the 1st of next month.

michelle: Backdating policy: we allow retroactive effective dates up to 30 days prior to approval for extenuating business reasons, but backpay will be processed in the next payroll run after approval. Anything beyond 30 days needs VP approval + explanation and may require finance sign-off.

olivia: For international hires moving between countries (same company role), do we need an additional relocation/immigration sign-off?

michelle: Yes — if the change involves a change in country of employment, get People Ops Mobility and Legal looped in before submitting. That will add runway for work-authorisation checks.

sam: Any required wording managers should use on the evidence form? Want to avoid extra clarifying threads.

michelle: Recommended manager evidence template (paste into the form comments):

```
1) One-line summary of change (title/band/target comp).
2) Business justification — scope change, new responsibilities, product/metric impact. Include quant metrics where possible (e.g., led rollout -> +18% DAU).
3) Specific examples of work in the last 12 months mapped to the leveling rubric sections (scope, autonomy, impact).
4) Calibration note — peers/benchmarks used.
5) Manager sign-off with date and expected effective date.
```

michelle: Also attach 1-2 artifacts (PRs, customer feedback, architecture doc, demo link) — small files or links suffice.

peopleops-bot: [automated] Manager evidence form received for Sam's submission. Reference ID: MEF-2026-1749994321. A People Ops reviewer will respond within 3 business days.

sam: Perfect, thanks. One last Q — if manager wants the raise to be effective as of the start of FY and payroll cutoff missed, is it better to do approval now and process backpay, or hold until next cycle?

michelle: Approve now and process backpay. That ensures compensation gets corrected in the records immediately and payroll can handle lumpsum backpay in the next run. Make sure manager notes the requested retro date and business justification in the form.

olivia: Noted — I'll grab the sample artifacts and remind engineering managers to use the template. :+1:

sam: Thanks everyone!
